title: fix(types): a runtime census of the form-field channel; declare the keys field widgets read, keep field-level `defaultValue` / `defaultChecked` refused (objectui#12130)
body:
Part of #12130
Clause-②: yes

Declaring the measured keys widens the strict authoring face's accept set on `fields[]` entries; their value checks narrow the tolerant face, where the same keys used to be stripped unjudged.

This PR closes nothing. It lands the census, its enumeration pin, fourteen declarations, and the measured refusal of `defaultValue` / `defaultChecked`. The three read keys under "Decisions left open" (`step`, `avatarField` / `avatar_field`, `className`) stay with the card for its next round (seat amendment `6112222681`).

Implemented by the os-dev dispatched from the `domain:spec` @ objectui seat, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01V8qYZseSLfKH3V8tPu2f73`, claim comment 6111358337. Base: `main` at `a7d4920` (one commit past the claimed `158c75d`; it touches only `packages/app-shell` and `packages/plugin-detail`).

## What changed

**1. A runtime census of the form-field channel, committed before any declaration** (`examples/schema-catalog/test/form-field-channel-census-12130.test.tsx`).

The `form` renderer hands each `fields[]` entry to its field widget twice: as the metadata carrier (`field: field.field || field` in the one `renderFieldComponent` call of `renderers/form/form.tsx`) and as props, because the entry's leftover keys are spread into the widget's props bag. The census renders every built-in branch, every registered `field:` widget and one unregistered type (the default branch) in three states (empty; read-only with a value; disabled with a value) through the real `SchemaRenderer`. Two recording proxies log every read of an ABSENT key: one over the entry, attributed to the source module on the stack, and one over each widget's props. A props read counts only when the entry can deliver it: the census re-renders with the key written on the entry and keeps it only if the widget receives that exact value. The pin asserts that the keys read and not declared on `FormFieldSchema` are exactly a ledger, with the readers each row records. A widget that starts reading a new undeclared key turns it red, naming the key and the reader.

**2. What each key does** (`form-field-channel-effects-12130.test.tsx`, real registrations; `form-field-channel-components-only-12130.test.tsx`, without `@object-ui/fields`). Every ledgered key that is declared here is rendered without and with it, and the widget's observable changes. Each case's first render is its control.

**3. Declarations** (`packages/types/src/form.ts` `FormField`, `packages/types/src/zod/form.zod.ts` `FormFieldSchema`, kept in parity):

| key | how declared | read by (census) | measured effect |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `language` | spec `FieldSchema` by reference | `code` | the editor asks for code in it |
| `maxSize` | spec by reference | `file`, `image` | a larger pick is refused before upload |
| `allowCreate` | spec by reference | `lookup`, `master_detail` | `false` withdraws the create offer |
| `descriptionField` | spec by reference | `lookup`, `master_detail` | the record field under each option |
| `displayField` | spec by reference | `lookup`, `master_detail`, `user` | each option's label |
| `lookupColumns` | spec by reference | `lookup`, `master_detail` | the browse-all dialog's columns |
| `lookupFilters` | spec by reference | `lookup`, `master_detail`, `user` | the candidate query's filter |
| `lookupPageSize` | spec by reference | `lookup`, `master_detail` | the browse-all dialog's page size |
| `idField` | `LookupFieldMetadata` member by reference | `lookup`, `master_detail` | the record field a pick submits |
| `picker` | `UserFieldMetadata` member by reference | `lookup`, `master_detail`, `user` | `search` replaces quick-select and dialog |
| `subtitle` | `UserFieldMetadata` member by reference | `lookup`, `master_detail`, `user` | record fields beside each search candidate |
| `capture` | as the `file` widget reads it: `'environment' \| 'user' \| false` | `file` | adds a camera input in that mode |
| `crop` | as the `image` widget reads it: `boolean` | `image` | `false` removes the crop action |
| `defaultName` | as the `avatar` widget reads it: `string` | `avatar` | the name the empty avatar's initials come from |

The face is flat: each key is accepted on every field type and read only by the widgets named (H6 below). The census re-derives that column on every run (`DECLARED_BY_12130`).

**4. The two keys the card named stay refused.** No reader on the channel asks for `defaultValue` or `defaultChecked` by name (asserted by the census). They reach a control only through the built-in branches' spread of leftover entry keys, and neither becomes the field's value on any type measured, with or without `@object-ui/fields`: a checkbox or switch with `defaultChecked: true` stays `aria-checked="false"` and submits `false`; a field with `defaultValue` submits no value. Each case's control seeds the same value through `FormSchema.defaultValues` and reads it back. The strict face keeps refusing both by name (pinned in `packages/types/src/__tests__/form-field-channel-keys-12130.test.ts`). So `packages/types/examples/login-form.ts` drops its inert `defaultChecked: false` and `content/docs/components/form/form.mdx` drops the field-level `defaultValue`, pointing at `defaultValues`.

**5.** `form-field-zod-coverage.test.ts`'s declared key list gains the keys; one `.changeset/12130-form-field-channel-keys.md` (`@object-ui/types`: minor, breaking semantics stated).

## Readings per mechanism hypothesis

- **H1 confirmed.** The channel is the `renderFieldComponent(resolvedType, { ...fieldProps, field: field.field || field, ...formField, … })` call inside `renderFormField`. The census controls show the entry proxy reaching the form renderer (`visibleWhen`), a widget's carrier read (`scale` by `NumberField`, `reference` by `LookupField`) and a widget's props read (`dependsOn` by `MultiSelectField`).
- **H2 confirmed, with one correction.** `FormFieldSchema` is one flat `z.object` declaring neither key. `FormField` declares neither either, but it carries an index signature, so the TypeScript face never refused them: only the strict zod face did.
- **H3 answered: the registry set, not timing or host.** With components only, `text` takes the unregistered default branch, which spreads leftover entry keys onto a native input, so `defaultValue` is drawn (the card's reading, pointer case B). With `@object-ui/fields`, `text` resolves to `field:text`, whose `toDomProps` whitelist drops the key: empty (pointer case E). `input` is a built-in branch that writes `value={value ?? ''}` after its spread: empty in both (cases A and F). The built-in `textarea` draws it in both sets. The same readings hold with the real lazy registrations and with eagerly resolved widgets. In no case does the value reach the submit. The card's `checked=""` reading is Radix's hidden bubble input; the visible box stays unchecked.
- **H4: no reading moves.** PR objectui#12133's seed check (`isServerOwnedValue`) reads `field.field.defaultValue`, the object-field stash, never the entry's own key. Measured: a CEL envelope on the entry's own `defaultValue` still seeds `false` and submits `false`; the same envelope under `field.defaultValue` leaves the box unseeded.
- **H5 confirmed and wider.** See the census ledger; fourteen keys are declared here and the remaining rows are classified below.
- **H6 measured.** The reader column of the table above is the full list; on every other type, the built-in branches included, each declared key is accepted and read by nothing. Same shape as objectui#11070's flat grid keys.
- **H7.** Installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0, `liveness/field.json`, `props.defaultValue`: `{"status":"live","evidence":"packages/objectql/src/engine.ts"}`, the same as the seat's source reading. It records the engine applying an object field's default on insert, which reaches a form only through the `field.field` stash (H4), not through the entry's own key.
- **H8 confirmed.** `login-form.ts` carried `defaultChecked: false`, not `true`. The census rules the key inert, so it is removed.

## Decisions left open (not declared; each is a ledger row marked OPEN)

- **`step`.** Read and effective (`number` sets its input step). But `ObjectForm` (`@object-ui/plugin-form`) writes `step: 'any'` onto the entries it builds, which the spec's numeric `FieldSchema.step` refuses: declared by reference, `@object-ui/plugin-form` stops compiling (measured in the scoped build). Options: (A) declare by reference and have `ObjectForm` stop writing `'any'` (a plugin-form change, excluded from this dispatch; its own comment says the registered widgets derive their own step anyway); (B) declare `number | 'any'` on both faces, departing from the spec; (C) rule it runtime-only. Recommendation: A.
- **`avatarField` / `avatar_field`.** The `lookup` and `user` widgets read both, snake_case first; `UserFieldMetadata` declares the snake_case one; this face is camelCase (objectui#11610); the spec declares neither. Options: (A) declare `avatarField` and retire the snake_case read and member in the snake-to-camel family; (B) declare `avatar_field` by reference; (C) runtime-only. Recommendation: A.
- **`className` on a field entry.** Read off props by several widgets and forwarded to the control by the rest; on a built-in branch it replaces the branch's own classes. Options: (A) declare it as the control's classes; (B) leave it refused (layout goes through `colSpan` / `span` / `fieldContainerClass`); (C) declare it for the field row, a renderer change. No recommendation without a ruling on which element it styles.

The other ledger rows keep their refusal, each by an existing rule: second spellings (`allow_create`, `lookup_columns`, `lookup_page_size`, `reference_field`, `defaultCurrency`; AGENTS.md #0.1), runtime values no document can carry (`dataSource`, `onCreateNew`, `onUploadingChange`), and runtime-only keys already ruled (`field` objectui#6609, `mobile_fullscreen` objectui#3245, `currency` objectui#11070 round 13).

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface.** The claim listed `packages/types/src/__tests__/` for the enumeration pin. The runtime census cannot live there: `@object-ui/types` is zero-dependency, and a test importing `@object-ui/components` / `@object-ui/fields` / `@object-ui/react` fails `check:phantom-deps`. It lives in `examples/schema-catalog/test/`, which declares those packages and already holds objectui#11070's runtime pins. The face pin is in `packages/types/src/__tests__/`. The three census files are new; no other claim holds them.
- **Census bounds.** Reads made only inside an interaction handler are not enumerated (the census renders, it does not click). The built-in branches' spread of leftover keys onto a native control or a Radix primitive is an open set read by no name; keys that work only there are measured by the effects files, not the census. The development-mode schema validator's reads are dropped.
- **Renderer readings, not fixed here (findings, for the seat to file):** a field-level `defaultValue` is drawn by the built-in `textarea` branch (both registry sets) and by the default branch (components only) but never submitted, so the user sees text that is not saved; `defaultChecked` checks only Radix's hidden bubble input. Same seam: the built-in branches' spread of leftover entry keys onto the control.

## Verification (at `9a81311`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/example-schema-catalog type-check`: exit 0. `tsc --listFiles` confirms both test projects compile the new test files.
- `vitest run packages/types/`: 369 files, 10177 tests passed. `vitest run examples/schema-catalog/`: 45 files, 2341 passed. `vitest run scripts/__tests__/`: 180 files passed, 2 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/cli...' build`, then `pnpm check`: `286 validated, 147 recognised but not validated, 0 did not validate`. `objectui validate` on a form using `displayField`, `language`, `maxSize`, `capture`: valid. On one carrying `defaultChecked` / `defaultValue`: refused by name.
- Scoped build (`turbo run build` over the `check-doc-snippet-types --build-filter` set): 35 of 35 tasks. Then `check-doc-snippet-types`, `check-doc-example-types`, `check-doc-json-fences`, `check-doc-component-types`, `check-prompt-component-keys`, `check:doc-fences`: all exit 0.
- `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only; no row names `FormField`), `check:spec-symbols`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:phantom-deps`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check-lint-coverage`, and the five changeset gates: all exit 0.
- Targeted eslint (`--no-inline-config --format json`) on the 8 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files: 8 files, 0 errors, 9 warnings, all `no-explicit-any` at pre-existing lines of `form.ts` (the base file reads 9 too). The population is `eslint.config.js`'s `**/*.{ts,tsx}` minus its global ignores; no config enables type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- **Ablation, committed state, trap-restored, `git diff HEAD` empty after:** (1) `FormField.capture` widened to `any`: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` in `packages/types` exits 2 on two of the face pin's type assertions. (2) `language` removed from `FormFieldSchema`: the census turns red with `unexpected: ["language ← entry@fields/src/widgets/CodeField.tsx"]`. The census reads `@object-ui/types/zod` through the vitest alias to `src`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.
